# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_tx_manager (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the transmission manager.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `queue_buffers` (String) Total amount of hardware Tx buffers allocated to all ports linked to this transmission manager. Accepts a percentage, an amount of bytes, or `auto`.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `hw_id` (Number) The index the transmission manager occupies in the switch chip.
- `hw_offloaded` (Boolean) Whether the transmission manager is programmed into the switch chip.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
